comment_regular: Verified XGLB mutator: update the stored TESGlobal* when nonnull; remove the extra when null; otherwise allocate a 16-byte ExtraGlobal payload. During plugin load the stored dword is a FormID temporarily; ExtraDataList_ResolveLoadedFormIDs rebases, looks it up, RTTI-checks TESGlobal, and removes missing/wrong-type entries.
